text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of an accessible parking space on the north and south sides of Whitmore Avenue, west of Marlee Avenue. The accessible parking space will alternate from one side of the street to the other with the existing alternate side parking. The installation of the accessible parking space will address the needs of a local resident, while reducing the available on-street parking by one space.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible parking space to operate from the 16th day of each month to the last day of each month, April 1st to November 30th on the north side of Whitmore Avenue, between a point 158 metres west of Marlee Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further west. 2. Designated an accessible parking space to operate from the 1st day of each month to the 15th day of each month, April 1st to November 30th and from December 1st to March 31st on the south side of Whitmore Avenue, between a point 161 metres west of Marlee Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further west.
